Choosing a Professional AC Gas Filling Service

Pros of Professional Service

  • Correct Diagnosis: Experts accurately find the root cause, like a Vadodara AC gas leak repair need, not just topping up.
  • Right Equipment: Use of vacuum pumps and pressure gauges ensures correct gas quantity and system health.
  • Safety & Guarantee: Professional handling of high-pressure refrigerants and a service guarantee. We offer a 3-month guarantee on services and parts.
  • Longevity: Proper professional AC gas filling service extends your AC’s lifespan and efficiency.

Cons of Unprofessional / DIY

  • Damage Risk: Overfilling or using the wrong gas can permanently damage the compressor.
  • Ineffective: Without fixing the leak, the gas will escape again, wasting money.
  • Safety Hazards: Refrigerants are hazardous and require special handling to avoid injury or environmental harm.
  • No Warranty: Any damage caused will not be covered by a warranty.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does AC gas filling cost in Vadodara?

The AC gas filling cost Vadodara varies based on the AC type (Split/Window), capacity (tons), and refrigerant type (R32, R410A, R22). On average, split AC gas filling charges in Vadodara range from ₹2500 to ₹4500. For an exact quote, please call Atlas Aircon.

What are the signs of low AC gas?

Common signs include the AC not cooling effectively, ice formation on the coils, hissing sounds from the unit, and higher than usual electricity bills. If you notice these, you likely need a professional AC gas leak repair and refill.

How long does AC gas refilling take?

A standard AC gas charging Vadodara procedure, including leak detection and charging, typically takes between 45 to 90 minutes, depending on the complexity of the issue.

Do you provide a guarantee on AC gas filling?

Yes, Atlas Aircon provides a 3-month guarantee on our AC gas refilling service and any parts used during the repair. We stand by the quality of our work for all AC service with gas filling Vadodara.

Which refrigerant gases do you use?

We handle all common types of refrigerants, including R32, R410a, and R22. Our technicians will use the specific gas recommended for your Voltas, LG, or Daikin AC gas refilling Vadodara.

Is AC gas top up Gujarat a good idea?

An AC gas top up is only a temporary solution if there’s a slow leak. For a permanent fix, we always recommend a full leak test and repair before refilling. This is included in our professional AC gas filling service.

Do I need an annual maintenance contract with gas filling for AC in Gujarat?

Yes, an AMC is highly recommended. Regular maintenance can prevent gas leaks in the first place. Our AMCs often include free or discounted gas top-ups, providing great value and preventing unexpected high costs.
